name: Hina Yuusuke
source:
Age: Deceased (died at age 18)

Yuusuke was [url=/c11811]Haruto[/url]'s childhood friend and [url=/c11715]Asuka[/url]'s older brother.
He was involved in the process of completing the planning for a film he thought of when he died in an accident one year prior to the events of the game. 
Yuusuke always talked like a theorist and he was the centerpiece of Haruto's group of friends.

[Translated from [url=http://www.success-corp.co.jp/software/sl2000/memories_off_5/character.html]the official site[/url] and partly taken from [url=http://myanimelist.net/anime/1071/Memories_Off_5]MAL[/url].]
